name: Machiawase
source:
Saturday morning. Tokyo Station. Ritsuka was waiting for Sakurako.

But even after the agreed time, Sakurako didn’t show up. Thinking she might have forgotten the meeting place, Ritsuka sent her a message before heading to the platform and boarding the train.

The person sitting in the seat they had reserved wasn’t Sakurako—but someone who looked just like her. A stranger named Aoi.

As Ritsuka stood there, confused by Aoi’s presence—and the fact that she was crying in someone else’s seat—the train departed, marking the unexpected beginning of Ritsuka and Aoi’s journey together.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3576890/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
星期六早上。东京站。立夏正在等待樱子。

但即使过了约定的时间，樱子也没有出现。以为她可能忘记了见面地点，立夏给她发了一条信息，然后前往站台登上了火车。

坐在他们预定的座位上的人不是樱子——而是一个和她长得一模一样的人。一个名叫葵的陌生人。

当立香站在那里，对葵的出现感到困惑时——以及她在别人座位上哭泣的事实——火车出发了，标志着立香和葵一起旅程的意外开始。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3576890/]Steam[/url]]
